'''2011 Luxembourg Regionals Chris Menzel LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2011 Luxembourg Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Supreme Chancellor Chris' Profit 2010
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
